author: Kushal
problem: Read an undirected graph with N vertices and M edges and print its number of connected components.
bug_description: The search loops over G[i] (the start vertex) instead of G[x] (the popped vertex), so only direct neighbours of the start vertex are reached.

comments.accurate: Counts connected components with an iterative depth-first search
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts groups formed by each unvisited vertex together with its direct neighbours
comments.wrong_location: Neighbour loop verified; check that edges are stored with 0-based vertex numbers
